insights.heading: Market Insights
insights.subheading: Our trading desk's perspective on gold market trends, seasonal demand, and investment outlook.

articles.title: Gold Holds Strong Above ₹74,000 per 10g Amid Global Uncertainty
articles.summary: Gold prices have remained resilient above the ₹74,000 per 10g mark through Q3 2026, supported by sustained central bank buying, a weaker dollar, and elevated geopolitical risk premiums. Our desk expects continued support at current levels with potential upside into the festive season.

articles.title: Festive Season Demand: What Jewellers Should Know
articles.summary: Navratri and Diwali typically drive a 15–25% spike in physical gold demand across Gujarat. Jewellers who lock in bulk orders in September historically benefit from pre-festive pricing before the seasonal premium kicks in. Our trading desk is accepting advance bookings now.

articles.title: Sovereign Gold Bonds vs Physical Gold: A Practical Guide for Investors
articles.summary: SGBs offer a 2.5% annual interest advantage over physical gold but lack the immediacy and flexibility of bullion. For investors with a 5+ year horizon and no near-term liquidity needs, SGBs remain compelling. For jewellers and those needing physical delivery, certified bullion remains the preferred route.

items.title: MCX Spot Price
items.description: The Multi Commodity Exchange of India sets the benchmark domestic gold price, tracking international LBMA rates adjusted for import duty and currency.

items.title: USD/INR Exchange Rate
items.description: Gold is priced globally in US dollars. A weaker rupee directly raises domestic gold prices, even when international prices are flat.

items.title: Import Duty
items.description: India levies import duty on gold, currently at 15% (including GST). Any change in duty rates has an immediate and significant impact on domestic prices.

items.title: Central Bank Buying
items.description: RBI and global central banks have been net buyers of gold since 2022, providing a structural floor to prices and reducing downside risk.

items.title: Festive & Wedding Demand
items.description: India's festive calendar — Navratri, Diwali, Dhanteras, and wedding season — creates predictable seasonal demand spikes, particularly in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

items.title: Global Risk Sentiment
items.description: Gold is a safe-haven asset. Geopolitical tensions, equity market volatility, and inflation concerns all drive investors toward gold, pushing prices higher.
